Class BuffStacked

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Stats

ShapeEngine.dll

Represents a buff that supports stacking and timing, allowing for multiple stacks and optional duration-based degradation.

Remarks

BuffStacked extends BuffTimed to provide stack management and advanced duration handling. CurStacks stores the actual active stack count.
